p2.key: Carbon dioxide and water (CO2 and H2O) — both needed.

C6H5OH + 7O2 → 6CO2 + 3H2O

Balance C (6) and H (6 → 3H2O) first, then O: products have 12 + 3 = 15 O; phenol supplies 1, so 14 O = 7O2. State symbols not required.

Any two:

  • carbon monoxide (and/or carbon/soot) is produced;
  • CO is toxic – it binds to haemoglobin (carboxyhaemoglobin), reducing oxygen transport;
  • soot particulates damage the respiratory system.

C5H12 (pentane) releases more heat per gram.

Any two reasons:

  • Pentanol has a greater molar mass (88 vs 72 g mol−1), so there are fewer moles in 1 g, while both form 5 CO2 per mole.
  • Pentanol already contains an O atom – it is partially oxidized, so that part of the molecule releases no further energy.
  • Data-booklet analogues (e.g. butane vs butan-1-ol) show a smaller ΔHc for the alcohol.
  • Energy is also needed to overcome the hydrogen bonding in pentanol.

(Check: ≈48.6 kJ g−1 for pentane vs ≈37.8 kJ g−1 for pentanol.)

Improvements (two):

  • Fewer/no particulates (soot, C), CO or VOCs, because CNG (methane) burns more completely.
  • Less/no SO2/SO3, because CNG contains little or no sulfur impurity.

Reason (one): CO is toxic; SO2 causes acid rain (and is toxic/respiratory irritant).

N2H4/F2 is the better rocket fuel:

  • It produces more moles of gas per mole of hydrazine (5 vs 3), giving more thrust.
  • It is more exothermic (−1179 vs −585 kJ per mole of hydrazine).
N2 and H2O (from O2) are harmless, but the fluorine reaction produces HF, which is toxic and acidic, and harmful to the environment.

Local pollutant: carbon monoxide (or unburnt hydrocarbons/VOCs, or NO).
Global pollutant: carbon dioxide (greenhouse gas) or nitrogen oxides.
Simple alkanes like methane are not accepted as local pollutants.

(i) Formed by high-temperature combustion, e.g. in car or jet engines (N2 + O2 react); also lightning. "Burning" or "cars" alone is not enough.

(ii) Nitric acid, HNO3 (or nitrous acid, HNO2).

(iii) Any one: acid rain or deposition, photochemical smog, respiratory problems, damage to trees and lakes. "Air pollution" alone is not accepted.
The products (N2, CO2, H2O) are non-toxic, normal components of the atmosphere. No HCl or chlorine compounds form (unlike with NH4ClO4), and no nitrogen oxides. "Non-polluting" alone is not accepted.

C₄H₉OH + 6O₂ → 4CO₂ + 5H₂O

Oxygen count: products have 8 + 5 = 13 O; ethanol supplies 1, so 12 O = 6 O₂.
SO2 gas is produced, which is toxic/an irritant to the respiratory system (also pungent). “Causes acid rain” is not accepted.
2C2H2(g) + 5O2(g) → 4CO2(g) + 2H2O(l) (or C2H2 + 2.5O2 → 2CO2 + H2O). Complete combustion gives only CO2 and H2O.
